encodings.note: Fast call to privilege level 0 system procedures.

exceptions.when: If the LOCK prefix is used.
The SYSENTER instruction is not recognized in real-address mode.
If the LOCK prefix is used.
Same exceptions as in protected mode.
If the LOCK prefix is used.

If CR4.FRED = 0 and IA32_SYSENTER_CS[15:2] = 0. If FRED event delivery of SYSENTER would load RIP with a non-canonical address. If FRED event delivery of SYSENTER would load SSP with an address that is not 8-byte aligned. If a shadow-stack access performed by FRED event delivery of SYSENTER uses a non-canonical address or causes a LASS violation.
If an ordinary stack access performed by FRED event delivery of SYSENTER uses a non-canonical address or causes a LASS violation.
If a memory access performed by FRED event delivery of SYSENTER causes a page fault.
Same exceptions as in compatibility mode.
